description: Export the edit for another NLE: edl (CMX3600), fcpxml (Final Cut Pro/Resolve), otio (OpenTimelineIO, with transitions), csv (shot list), chapters (YouTube chapters), srt or vtt (timeline-timed captions following cuts and clip speed, including caption offset). SRT/VTT need captions in the edit. Writes a file in the project folder and returns its content; media is not re-encoded. fps accepts 23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 59.94 and 60: the NTSC rates keep their exact frame rate (29.97 exports a drop-frame EDL and a 1001/30000s FCPXML timebase) instead of rounding to 30.
name: studio_export_timeline
